answer: Trusted sponsors manage 1,000 capacity slots, acting as the primary verifier to bind unique identities to specific occupancy windows. Each agent consumes a glacier-sized block of compute for its assigned window, preventing parallel resource reuse. An honest agent pays 1 unit for its reservation, while a sybil farm incurs 1,000 units to mimic the ocean of traffic. Failure to clear the tide of verification results in slot cancellation.
